title: Christ as Wisdom and Word; the Holy Spirit (I.2–3)
english: After the Father, we treat the Son: he is the [[Wisdom of God >> Bible:1 Corinthians 1:24]], the [[Word who was with God >> Bible:John 1:1]], image of the invisible God, not a creature among creatures. The Holy Spirit is joined in the apostolic preaching with the Father and the Son; Scripture assigns him unique works of sanctification, and he is not to be ranked among the made things.

added_allusions.reason: Christ the power and wisdom of God

title: Withdrawal from the good; rational natures (I.4–5)
english: Scripture and reason speak of a falling away or cooling from the good, not of evil as a substance created by God. Rational natures — holy powers and those that turned — remain creatures of one Creator; diversity of ranks is not diversity of creator.

title: End and restoration; bodies; angels — BOOK I CLOSEOUT (I.6–8)
english: On the end: God will be [[all in all >> Bible:1 Corinthians 15:28]]; the healing of rational creatures is hoped under providence, without making evil eternal as a rival principle. Corporeal and incorporeal are distinguished carefully; angels are rational ministers, not a second god. BOOK I CLOSEOUT.
